headline: Lots of Indonesian Money Flows Out, Primary Income Deficit Reaches US$9.5 B
summary: Indonesia's current account deficit narrowed to $2.0 billion in the third quarter of 2026. The primary income deficit remained high at $9.5 billion.
why: The current account balance shows the net flow of trade and income with the rest of the world, which influences the rupiah and foreign-capital needs.
original_headline: Banyak Uang RI Kabur ke Luar, Defisit Pendapatan Primer Capai US$9,5 M
